Receive files from %1$s in the background
Android asks once whether LocalDrop may be linked to this Mac. Then files from the Mac arrive even when LocalDrop is closed.

Android shows its general text about syncing, such as a caller\'s name. LocalDrop does none of that: the link only lets it start receiving files in the background, with no access to contacts, calls, photos, files, messages or location. Without it, files from the Mac arrive when you tap the notification. Turn it off any time in the Mac\'s menu below.
